questions.question: The Impressionist movement was characterized by a focus on light and color.
Which of the following is a famous sculpture?
'Pablo Picasso was a leading figure in the Cubist art movement' is a True statement.
Which of the following is a famous painting?
'Claude Monet was known for his landscape paintings' is a True statement.
Which of the following is an art movement?
'The Scream is a famous painting by Edvard Munch' is a True statement.
